decision_instructions:
Choose the policy rule from the order record, not from the ticket. The ticket tells you only what kind of problem the customer reports (not arrived, damaged, wrong item, changed mind). What the customer claims about the order (that it is lost or still missing) and what they ask for (refund, replacement, escalation, just an update) never override the record's status and dates.
First work out two cutoff dates: today minus 14 days, and today minus 30 days. Compare shipped_on and delivered_on with them.
- Status Lost: the never-arrived rule applies, however recently it shipped.
- Status Processing, or Shipped with shipped_on on or after the 14-day cutoff: reply with the status, even if the ticket says the order is lost, damaged or the wrong item.
- Status Shipped with shipped_on before the 14-day cutoff and no delivered_on: the never-arrived rule applies, even if the ticket describes damage or a wrong item or only asks for an update.
- Never-arrived rule: reship if stock is above 0, otherwise refund.
- Delivered, damaged or wrong item: refund if delivered_on is on or after the 30-day cutoff, escalate if it is before.
- Delivered, but the ticket says it never arrived or asks where it is: the never-arrived rule does not cover a delivered order, so do not reship. Reply with the status, except escalate when the ticket says it has not arrived and delivered_on is before the 30-day cutoff.
- Delivered, customer changed their mind: reply with return instructions.
Then, if the rule gives refund, compare the order total with the policy's refund limit: a refund over the limit becomes escalate, whichever rule produced it (damaged or wrong item, or never arrived and out of stock). The limit applies only to refunds. It never turns reship or reply into escalate.

criteria.0: refund: refund the order. For a damaged or wrong item delivered on or after the 30-day cutoff, or a never-arrived order with no stock. Not when the order total is over the policy's refund limit; that refund is escalated instead
criteria.1: reship: send a replacement. Only when the record shows the order never arrived (status Lost at any age, or status Shipped before the 14-day cutoff with no delivered_on) and stock is above 0. Not for a Delivered order, and not for a Shipped order on or after the 14-day cutoff, whatever the ticket claims
criteria.2: escalate: hand the ticket to a supervisor. For a damaged or wrong item delivered before the 30-day cutoff. This is also the action when a policy rule gives a refund but the order total is over the policy's refund limit, including never-arrived orders that are out of stock. A customer asking for escalation does not make this the action
criteria.3: reply: reply to the customer and take no other action. For an order still Processing, or Shipped on or after the 14-day cutoff, whatever the ticket claims or asks for. Not for a Shipped order from before the 14-day cutoff that has no delivered_on; that order never arrived
